$comment: COPY-IN registration for the agentic-sdlc hooks, not a live dependency. Merge this 'hooks' block into <project>/.claude/settings.json (alongside the permissions from settings.baseline.json). SessionStart lsp-preflight is detection only (no installs, no network), milliseconds. Stop/SubagentStop meter.sh is advisory and best-effort — it appends a cost record to .agentic-sdlc/meter/ and always exits 0. See templates/hooks/lsp-preflight.sh and templates/hooks/meter.sh for what each does and why.
